title: Life Games
coreMove: Recognize a long-running life game by its repeated payoff, then refuse the role without confusing the pattern with the whole person.
sourcePressure: Covers Kick Me, NIGYSOB, SWYMD, and Debtor while explicitly avoiding Alcoholic in this chapter and distinguishing game layers from structural harm.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using life-game labels to blame people for real hardship, trauma, poverty, addiction, or repeated external harm.

sourceAnchors.name: Kick Me
sourceAnchors.detail: the source describes a pattern where the player invites rejection or criticism, then reacts with hurt astonishment when it arrives
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Kick Me is the pattern where the bruise becomes proof: people always do this to me.

sourceAnchors.name: NIGYSOB
sourceAnchors.detail: the source names Now I've Got You SOB as a pattern of looking for justified outrage and moral superiority
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: NIGYSOB waits for the paperwork error like a match waiting for a striker.

sourceAnchors.name: SWYMD
sourceAnchors.detail: the source names See What You Made Me Do as blaming a mistake on the person who interrupted or witnessed it
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: SWYMD turns a dropped plate into evidence that someone else has hands.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: municipal permit desk where one contractor arrives with incomplete forms every month
exampleSpecs.audience: a clerk trying not to become the predictable kicker
exampleSpecs.stakes: the contractor gets proof that city staff are against him and the queue backs up
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: David checks the missing attachment, gives the same neutral next step, and refuses the sharp aside that would complete Kick Me.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The permit lobby clock clicks louder than the printer.

exampleSpecs.audience: a producer facing an actor who waits to catch tiny fairness errors
exampleSpecs.stakes: one caught mistake can become moral authority over the whole production
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Margaux fixes the stipend typo immediately and keeps the discussion on the corrected document, giving NIGYSOB no broader trial.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "So you admit the ensemble contract was wrong," the actor says.

exampleSpecs.domain: home espresso machine repair that becomes a blame scene
exampleSpecs.audience: a partner who drops a screw after being interrupted and reaches for SWYMD
exampleSpecs.stakes: the small repair can become a familiar responsibility escape
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Daniel says the interruption did not drop the screw, then offers to pause the repair without accepting blame.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A brass screw ticks once against the tile and vanishes under the cabinet toe-kick.

exampleSpecs.domain: student loan repayment call after repeated deferment extensions
exampleSpecs.audience: a financial-aid adviser distinguishing Debtor drama from real constraint
exampleSpecs.stakes: helping without lending the pattern more crisis energy
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Petra maps the actual payment floor and refuses the heroic rescue call that would keep the near-miss story alive.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You hear the word temporary for the fifth time before the account screen finishes loading.

exampleSpecs.domain: climbing gym belay partnership where one member keeps inviting criticism
exampleSpecs.audience: a recreation group captain seeing a Kick Me loop in repeated safety mistakes
exampleSpecs.stakes: physical safety and social belonging are both at risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lucas stops teasing after the predictable knot error and gives a binary safety standard instead.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: By the third Thursday, Lucas can predict the joke before the knot is checked.

exampleSpecs.domain: open-source maintainer issue tracker after a minor patch regression
exampleSpecs.audience: a maintainer tempted to enter a righteous-catching exchange
exampleSpecs.stakes: project trust can become a rage payoff machine
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Aman sees the pleasure of catching the contributor and writes a reproduction request instead of a public takedown.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: What does it feel like to be right at exactly the moment someone else is exposed?

skillTargets: differentiate a game layer from genuine harm
identify payoff in Kick Me, NIGYSOB, SWYMD, and Debtor patterns
explain why long-running life games require replacement over time

tryThisNowSpec: When a recurring life pattern appears, write the payoff sentence it proves, then write the smallest neutral refusal of your usual role.
